verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents its own stale-flag detection feature, which automatically identifies flags so teams can clean them up. That covers the 'find stale flags' half of the story, but only through a single thin doc mention. Missing for 10: any evidence of code-reference scanning that locates where flags are used in the codebase, detail on how staleness is determined, any workflow tying detection to removal from code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can find stale flags and code references so temporary flags actually get removed from the codebase

citations.quote: GrowthBook can automatically detect these flags so you can clean them up.
